title: Ack::write_to position 62 uses different semantics than position 0-61
description:
Location: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:279 and 286

Issue: The bitmap bit positions use different indexing in different loops:
- Line 279: `self.bitmap & (1u64 << (62 - i))` for i in 0..first_byte_bits
- Line 286: `self.bitmap & (1u64 << (56 - i))` for i in 0..remaining

This creates a boundary at position 6 (between first_byte_bits and remaining) where the formula changes. While mathematically correct, the discontinuity is subtle and error-prone.

Verification needed: Confirm that when i=6 in the second loop, `56 - 0 = 56` corresponds to bitmap position 56, which should follow position 62 from the first loop. This suggests a gap: the first loop covers positions 62-57 (for i=0-5), and the second covers positions 56-0.

Actually this is correct: first loop handles 6 bits (positions 62-57 in bitmap), second loop handles remaining bits (positions 56 down to the truncation point).

Downgrading: This is not a bug but the code would benefit from comments explaining the two-phase encoding.
